# dsh-session-batch-manager — batch session manager and session dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
English | 中文
## 0 Overview
Batch session management for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): multi-select sessions in the sidebar and batch
**archive / unarchive / delete**, plus a full-screen **Session management** dashboard that visualize
s **model, token usage, cache read/write, and context pressure** for every local session.
The DSH GUI natively offers per-session archiving only — there is no delete entry at all. This plugi
vely offers per-session archiving only — there is no delete entry at all. This plugin fills the gap:
- a per-row checkbox **revealed by the Batch toggle** at the bottom of the sidebar (selection surviv

es leaving the mode and is cleared automatically when a batch operation completes);
- a floating too
lbar with select-all / clear / archive / delete, **stop-and-archive retry** for sessions with runnin
g work, and a **physical delete** pipeline (host route + confirmation dialog + immediate row removal

in every connected GUI);
- a **Session management** panel: a 6-column table (model, 4-bucket token
usage, cache read/write, context-pressure progress bar), two-pane tree view (main / archived) with c
ollapsible subagent nesting, fork sessions as independent tree roots, lineage-based archive/delete c
ascade, and a **recall** banner + checklist for re-attaching ungrouped sessions to workspaces.
Verified with DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 (Web UI, dev sandbox); see 6 Compatibility.

## 2 Features
### 2.1 Sidebar batch management
- **Selection mode**: the **Batch** toggle at the bottom of the sidebar. Checkboxes are hidden by de
fault and appear only in selection mode. While it is on, clicking anywhere on a row toggles its sele
ction (opening, double-click rename, drag-sorting and Enter/Space are taken over). The selection sur
vives leaving the mode — highlighted rows and the toolbar count stay; any batch operation (archive /

unarchive / delete) clears it when it completes, and **Clear** clears it manually.
- **Floating too
lbar** (bottom of the sidebar): appears whenever at least one session is selected, not only in selec
tion mode. Shows the selected count, **Select all**, **Clear**, **Archive** (switches to **Unarchive
** when every selected session is already archived), **Delete** (confirmation first) and **Exit** (s

election mode only).
- **Stop-and-archive retry**: when batch archiving meets sessions with running
work, they are reported separately and the result notice offers a one-click **Stop and archive N run

ning sessions** retry — the same upgrade path as the native DSH archive dialog.
- **Batch delete**:
the confirmation dialog lists the target sessions → the host route physically deletes their JSONL lo
g directories → `api-session/removed` is broadcast, so every connected GUI drops the rows immediatel

y. Deleted rows are additionally hidden by client-side tombstones (see 5 Safety and behavior).
- **C
ontext-menu entry** (optional contribution): **Batch select sessions** appears automatically on DSH
builds that ship a context-menu service; on 0.2.2-alpha.2 (which lacks it) the entry is silently abs
ent and nothing else is affected.
### 2.2 Session management dashboard
A gauge-icon button at the bottom of the sidebar opens a full-screen, read-only **Session management
** panel that scans every local session:
- **6-column table**: checkbox / session (title + running / subagent / archived / pinned badges + co
llapsible tree) / project / model (`provider/model`) / token usage (4-bucket total, per-bucket toolt

ip) / cache read · write / context pressure percentage (progress bar, warning color at ≥ 90%).
- **T
wo-pane filter**: **Main** (default, tree view with subagents nested under parent sessions) / **Arch
ived** with live counts. Fork sessions are independent tree roots with full operation parity. Switch

ing a pane clears the panel's selection set (independent from the sidebar's).
- **In-panel batch ope
rations**: archive / unarchive / delete reuse the same core pipeline as the sidebar, with their own

/ unarchive / delete reuse the same core pipeline as the sidebar, with their own selection.

## 6 Compatibility

| DeepSeek Harness (DSH) | dsh-session-batch-manager | Verified environment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **>=0.2.1** | `0.2.0` | Web UI (dev sandbox 0.2.2-alpha.2 — tree view E2E verified; recall GUI ve
rification in progress); Desktop App 0.2.1-rc.5 — coupling points statically verified, runtime TBD |
The plugin declares `dsh: ">=0.2.1"` in `engines`. **0.2.2-alpha.2** (dev sandbox, Web UI) has been
fully verified end-to-end. **Desktop App 0.2.1-rc.5**: all seven coupling points (slots, services, e
vents, `sessionQuery`) are present in the app bundle — static grep confirmation, runtime verificatio
n pending. Core features (batch archive/delete, sidebar checkboxes) use stable APIs available since
0.2.1. The session management dashboard stats use `sessionQuery`; on builds where this service is un
available the panel degrades gracefully to list + batch operations (see `degraded` flag).
On DSH builds without a context-menu service, the context-menu entry is silently absent — see 2.1.
This is a Cordis plugin with zero runtime dependencies: the host half is a plain ESM bundle, the cli
ent half is loaded through the DSH module loader.
